# wso2is_notification_template_type (Resource)

Creates a custom notification template type. Use a custom type for notifications that your own flows or adaptive scripts send. Deleting the type also deletes its templates. To import, use the ID `<channel>/<name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_notification_template_type" "contract_ready" {
  channel = "email"
  name    = "ContractReady"
}

resource "wso2is_notification_template" "contract_ready" {
  channel = "email"
  type    = wso2is_notification_template_type.contract_ready.name
  subject = "Your contract is ready"
  body    = "<p>Hi {{user-name}}, your contract is ready to sign.</p>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel` (String) `email` or `sms`.
- `name` (String) Template type name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<channel>/<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_notification_template_type.contract_ready email/ContractReady
```
